Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In Step 10, the WebSurfer agent failed to correctly interpret the search results. The search results explicitly stated from Wikipedia: "The mouth of Crum Creek is located at approximately 39°51′29″N latitude and 75°19′16″W longitude, where it drains into the **Delaware River**". Despite this clear text indicating the mouth is the Delaware River (not Ridley Creek), the Planner in Step 11 and the subsequent WebSurfer actions continued to incorrectly conclude that the mouth waterbody is "Ridley Creek". The error originated in the interpretation of the search result in Step 10, where the agent (or the Planner relying on it) ignored the direct statement that Crum Creek drains into the Delaware River and instead forced the "Ridley Creek" conclusion based on the proximity of the two creeks' mouths in the tidal marsh, contradicting the explicit search result.
